description: Client-side script for Employee Attendance Tool UI in ERPNext, managing employee attendance status, loading employee data, and UI interactions.

classes.name: MarkedEmployee
classes.description: Handles display of marked employee attendance statuses with icons and colors.

classes.name: EmployeeSelector
classes.description: UI component for selecting employees and marking attendance statuses.

methods.name: load_employees
methods.description: Fetches employee data based on selected filters and updates the UI sections for marked and unmarked employees.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Initializes the employee selection UI, including check/uncheck and attendance marking buttons.
